title: Co-floatation assay of VPS13C with SUVs
author: Dazhi Li
materials: Buffer D (200 mM NaCl, 25 mM HEPES, pH 7.5)
Subject the suspension to five freeze–thaw cycles.
For the flotation assay, mix 90 μL of the reaction with an equal volume of 60% OptiPrep (Cat. #D1556, Sigma Aldrich) to generate a 30% layer.

steps.title: Prepare lipid mixture
steps.instruction: Combine 16:0‑18:1 PC (POPC) (Avanti Polar Lipids Catalog #850457C), 16:0‑18:1 PE (Avanti Polar Lipids Catalog #850757), 18:1 DGS‑NTA(Ni) (Avanti Polar Lipids Catalog #790404C), and Rhod‑PE (Avanti Polar Lipids Catalog #810150) in chloroform at a molar ratio of 84.8:10:5:0.2.

steps.title: Dry lipid film
steps.instruction: Dry the lipid mixture under a gentle nitrogen stream and then desiccate under vacuum overnight to form a thin film.

steps.title: Rehydrate lipid film
steps.instruction: Rehydrate the dried film in buffer D (200 mM NaCl, 25 mM HEPES, pH 7.5, 1 mM TCEP) to a final lipid concentration of 10 mM.

steps.title: Extrude liposomes to SUVs
steps.instruction: Extrude the lipid suspension 31 times through a 200 nm polycarbonate filter using an Avanti Mini‑Extruder to generate small unilamellar vesicles (SUVs).

steps.title: Incubate SUV suspension
steps.instruction: Incubate the SUV suspension at 37 °C for 1 hour, mixing gently every 20 minutes.

steps.title: Mix protein with SUVs
steps.instruction: In a 100 µL reaction, combine 1–5 µg purified full‑length VPS13C or VPS13C‑ΔATG2C with 1 mM SUVs.

steps.title: Add Rab7A or control
steps.instruction: Add an equal mass of Rab7A(Q67L/T22N)-6xHis or 6xHis‑ATG7 (negative control) together with 1 mM GTP and 2 mM Mg²⁺, then incubate at room temperature for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Ultracentrifuge floated SUVs
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample to a 0.8 mL ultracentrifuge tube (Beckman Cat. #344090), overlay with 300 µL 20 % OptiPrep and 100 µL reconstitution buffer, and centrifuge at 193,911 × g for 1 hour in an SW‑55 Ti rotor at 18 °C.

substeps.instruction: Transfer sample to 0.8 mL ultracentrifuge tube (Cat. #344090, Beckman)
Overlay with 300 µL 20 % OptiPrep and 100 µL reconstitution buffer
Centrifuge at 193,911 × g for 1 hour in SW‑55 Ti rotor at 18 °C

steps.title: Collect top fraction
steps.instruction: Collect 100 µL from the top fraction that contains the floated SUVs.

steps.title: Run SDS-PAGE analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze a 10 µL input sample and 30 % of the top fraction by SDS‑PAGE on 3–8 % Tris‑acetate precast gels.

substeps.instruction: Take 10 µL of the input sample
Load samples onto 3–8 % Tris‑acetate precast gel

steps.title: Quantify floated protein
steps.instruction: Measure band intensities in ImageJ and calculate floated protein as (normalized top‑fraction intensity ÷ input intensity) × 100 %.

substeps.instruction: Calculate floated protein percentage as (top fraction / input) × 100
